summary.text: Brad von Gillern is a member of the Nebraska Legislature who has represented District 4 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Von Gillern was born in Lincoln, Nebraska, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nebraska, Lincoln in 1983.
His career experience includes working as a CEO.
Von Gillern assumed office in the Nebraska Legislature on January 4, 2023.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as chair of the Revenue Committee and member of Banking, Commerce and Insurance.
He advanced from the May 12, 2026 primary.
